lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps and introducing adoption new flows consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens and sign-in hints proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Finish layouts consistently degraded performance, resulting in guardrail rollbacks.
Home wait-info, adoption copy, finish hints, and finish notifications mostly showed no clear effect across repeated tests.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for single-test categories or kinds with contradictory results like adoption redesigns.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing tests and underestimated returns on winning tests.

candidates.title: upload_photos_photo_quality_guide_new_screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated photo quality guide screen before photo upload showing visual criteria and checklist for clear pet photos.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation fails or results look wrong. A photo guidance screen helps users provide better input photos.

new_photo_quality_guide.headline: Photo Quality Tips
new_photo_quality_guide.body: Ensure good lighting and a clear face view for the best custom pet results.

guard.reason: Valid addition of photo quality guide screen inside onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses ~25.5%. Both 3 support emails and funnel duration point to photo upload errors. Adoption new screens consistently win (+1.0%).

candidates.title: sign_in_account_switch_safety_hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear hint reminding returning users to log into their original account to preserve existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating account switching or accidental secondary account creation.

sign_in.hint: Logging back in? Use the same account you used before to keep your pet and progress safe.

guard.reason: Valid helpful hint added to the sign_in screen.

candidates.score_note: High volume of support emails (8) and sign-in drop-off align. Sign-in hints are proven winners (+2.9% average across 4 tests).

candidates.title: pick_friend_pet_care_preview_new_screen

candidates.why: Lessons show adoption new screens perform well, and 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to interact with pets.

new_pet_care_preview.headline: How Your Pet Lives On Desktop
new_pet_care_preview.body: Preview feeding, playing, and desktop interactions before finalizing your companion.

guard.reason: Valid new pet care preview screen added within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses ~25.5% of users with support emails showing post-onboarding confusion. Adoption new screens have positive historical returns (+1.0%).

candidates.title: sign_in_session_status_notification
candidates.change: Shows an interactive ready notification during authentication setup to signal active connection progress.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to open properly, leading to sign-in drop-off.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Pet
sign_in.hint: Secure authentication is connecting to save your pet online.

candidates.title: upload_photos_two_column_redesign

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Select clear photos of your pet from different angles for best results.

guard.reason: Valid two-column layout redesign of the upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: High adoption mean duration (1017s) suggests friction, but evidence for adoption redesigns remains mixed (+3.2% across 2 tests with contradictory results).

candidates.why: Choose path stage has a high mean duration of 514s despite low median (8s), showing long-tail user hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet's Journey
choose_path.body: Select whether to pick from pre-made pet friends or create a custom pet companion.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on choose_path screen maintaining dual path options.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path loses ~19.8% with long-tail duration. Choose_path copy has only 1 prior test (+2.0%), so evidence is thin.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_setup_progress_wait_info

candidates.why: Home wait step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-off during background initialization.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Setting up animations, sound effects, and desktop interactions.

guard.reason: Valid interactive preview stage screen added within onboarding flow.

candidates.title: story_onboarding_purpose_hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the story screen highlighting that onboarding takes under two minutes.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding conversion is only 26.4%; establishing short time commitment at the start reduces early drop-off.

story.hint: Setup takes only 2 minutes. Your pet will live right on your desktop!

guard.reason: Valid setup time informational hint added to story screen.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses ~19.8%. Choose_path hints show small positive returns (+0.5% across 3 tests) at low implementation cost.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps and introducing adoption new flows consistently hurt performance across multiple tests.
Finish screen layout changes consistently degraded performance, leading to multiple guardrail rollbacks.
Sign-in hints and adoption new screens proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Home wait-info features mostly showed no clear effect across repeated tests, despite one winning test.
Evidence remains mixed for adoption and choose-path redesigns, which produced both strong wins and significant losses.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing tests and underestimated the impact of winning tests.
